# Krish Khati | Software Developer & AI Specialist

> Krish Khati (also known as Krrish Dhiman) is a software developer and AI/digital marketing specialist based in Pundri, Haryana, India. He builds AI-powered tools, web applications, and automation projects, and works with Python, C, and modern AI APIs. Currently looking for an entry-level role or internship.

The site is a single-page app with prerendered HTML for every public page. Content may be summarized and cited with a link back to the source page.

## About

- **Name**: Krish Khati (also known as Krrish Dhiman)
- **Role**: Software Developer & AI/Digital Marketing Specialist
- **Location**: Pundri, Kaithal, Haryana, India
- **Stack**: Python, C, C++, JavaScript/TypeScript, React, Vite, Tailwind CSS, Supabase, LLM APIs (OpenAI, Gemini, Groq)
- **Focus**: AI-powered tools, web applications, automation projects, SEO and digital marketing
